notes: published_not_active: the published KID is NOT the active contract KID. The hosted signer fails closed while they differ, which is intentional — no Okta application trusts the new key yet. The endpoint is served by a DEDICATED static project, never by the V3 application, so there is exactly one authoritative JWKS URL. The final hostname awaits a DNS record at the registrar. Cutover is O2C.2.
hosting: dedicated static Vercel project idcaddie-staging-jwks; no auth, no cookies, no AWS credentials at request time
